submission.comment: Best strategy found: momentum with 37-day lookback, long-only, with volatility targeting. Achieves 1.385 annualized Sharpe ratio with 70.7% annual return, 51.0% annual volatility, 49.8% max drawdown, and 8.6% daily turnover. Tested 233 strategies across all families (momentum, ma_crossover, mean_reversion, breakout, rsi) with various parameter combinations and modifiers.
